  • Expedition

    "we've got the cleverest guides in this country, Henri and Lafayette Peace" (97)- Lafayette dies before Henri sends out the fiddle on the lake in 1888, and this expedition likely happened after Louis Riel's death as Lafayette Peace "fought with Riel"(119), so therefore sometime between 1885 and 1888.

  • Plague of doves

    "In the year 1896" (5) and when Seraph and Junesse run away it is "too early for there to be much else [than doves] to gather up in the way of food" (13) and they travel for "one whole summer" (15); therefore the plague of doves likely occurs in the winter and/or spring of 1896.

  • Mustache Maude stops lynching

    Seraph and Junesse live with Mustache Maude "for six years” (16) and meet her right after the plague of doves in 1896. The attempted lynching is the inciting incident to their departure so therefore it happens at the end of the six years.

  • Shamengwa inherits fiddle

    "1888 was the year. But the violin spoke to Shamengwa and called him out onto the lake in a dream almost twenty years later” (216), 1888 +20 years is 1908. In addition Shamengwa is “already twelve years old” (204), and if he is "five or six" sometime between 1896 and 1902, he must be twelve sometime between 1903 (1896+7 years) and 1908 (1902+6 years).

  • Bazil andC's affair

    Coutts describes Cordelia's hair as "gray strands" (282) which means he witnesses Cordelia's hair turn grey, likely sometime in her 30s. Cordelia is born in 1911 so she would be 30 in 1941 and 40 in 1951. Coutts also describes himself as "twenty-five" (279) years old around this time but he is "seventeen" (275) when the affair begins, so the affair lasts around ~8 years. Therefore, Coutts and Cordelia's affair takes place between 1933 and 1951 for ~8 years.

  • Bazil woosGeraldine

    Coutts and Geraldine are already together by the time Evelina learns about the lynching, as Geraldine is heard saying "[w]ho told you?" to Clemence regarding her relations with the judge, therefore they begin courting prior to September 1966 (*see Evelina learns of the lynching). The courting also must begin after Coutts and Cordelia's affair ends, as Coutts mentions his "pains in that department" (89), alluding to the end of his affair, therefore, Coutts courts Geraldine before October 1966 and after 1951.

  • Billy and John ransom Neve

    Neve exclaiming "'In this snow?'" (119) indicates that it is winter and on the same day John suggests that Billy kidnaps Neve "tomorrow night" (123). As Maggie is already pregnant, this happens within nine months of Corwin's birth and as Corwin is born in 1954 this must be in winter 1953/54.

  • Maggie has Corwin

    Corwin and Evelina are in sixth grade in 1966 (*see "Evelina kisses Corwin") and therefore ~12 years old. 1966-12=1954. Corwin was born in 1954.

  • Maggie has Corwin

    Corwin and Evelina are in sixth grade in 1966 (*see "Evelina kisses Corwin") and therefore ~12 years old. 1966-12=1954. Corwin was born in 1954.

  • Marn elopes with Billy

    Marn's children are reading the menu at the 4-B's in 1972, "[t]hey bent over the list, their mouths forming the words" (185) which would theoretically make them somewhere between age 4 and age 7, the general age range in which children learn to read. Marn states "I have been with Billy three years...I'm still only nineteen” (151) and has her children in this time as well (147). Considering Marn's children are still infants when she returns home with Billy, she likely has them in the second or third year of travel; if her children are ~4 in 1972 then Marn is ~18 in 1968 and if they are ~7 in 1972 then Marn is ~18 in 1965. If Marn has been with Billy three years at 19, then she elopes at 16, and therefore between 1966 and 1963.

  • Evelina kisses Corwin

    “mid-1960s,” (9) before “[w]e were in the sixth grade” (43). Evelina goes to college “in the fall of 1972” (221), (she goes to college right after highschool as she says "I was just about to graduate and was working at the 4-B's, saving up money for college" (184)) so she would be in sixth grade 6 years earlier which is 1966. This happens “[t]he day after Easter Monday” (19) which in 1966 is April 11th.

  • Marn gets her snakes

    Marn obtains her snakes “on our travels south” (160), “we wandered in the desert three years” (147) between the ages 16 and 19. The earliest Marn can be 16 is ~1963 (*see "Marn elopes with Billy") and the latest she can be 19 is ~1969 (i.e. the three years would be 1963-1966, and any three years in between, up to 1966-1969).

  • Marn gets her snakes

    Marn obtains her snakes “on our travels south” (160), “we wandered in the desert three years” (147) between the ages 16 and 19. The earliest Marn can be 16 is ~1963 (*see "Marn elopes with Billy") and the latest she can be 19 is ~1969 (i.e. the three years would be 1963-1966, and any three years in between, up to 1966-1969).

  • Marn has Judah and Lilith

    “we wandered in the desert three years and I bore two children” (147); Marn's children are reading the menu at the 4-B's in 1972, "[t]hey bent over the list, their mouths forming the words" (185) which would theoretically make them somewhere between age 4 and age 7, the general age range in which children learn to read. Considering Marn's children are still infants when she returns home with Billy, she likely has them in the second or third year of travel; if her children are ~4 in 1972 then Marn is ~18 in 1968 and if they are ~7 in 1972 then Marn is ~18 in 1965. Therefore Marn has Judah and Lilith between 1968 and 1965.

  • Warren put into state hospital

    Cordelia states that she treated Warren on the Wolde property "about twenty years ago"(309), and she is narrating in her "seventies" (299). Since she is born in 1911 she narrates between 1981 and 1991, therefore she treats Warren between 1961 and 1971. She then states that Warren lasted "pretty well for another few years before he went entirely senile and was sent down to the state hospital" (309-310). Assuming 'a few' is ~3 years, Warren is sent to the hospital between 1964 and 1974.

  • Corwin steals and plays fiddle

    Corwin steals the fiddle after "he dropped out of school” (197), he is also described as driving and "working a job" (198), which would suggest he is at least 16 years old, and he is the same age as Evelina so that would make the year 1970 if they were in grade 6 in 1966. This also checks out as after Corwin is caught, Shamengwa teaches Corwin the fiddle for 2 years before he passes away in 1972. Corwin starts learning in "the middle of September” (209) so therefore he must steal the violin before te end of September 1970.

  • ShamengwaCorwinplay

    “It was the middle of September” (209) when Corwin started practicing and “in early May” (210) Coutt's hears Corwin's progress. Another year passes: "Fall came...again...The summer went....Then Shamengwa died." (210). Therefore, Shamengwa starts teaching Corwin 2 years before he passes away, and he passes away before Evelina goes to college in fall 1972.

  • Edward loses his stamps

    “In late March” (266). Evelina describes this happening the following spring after she leaves the hospital, which would be March 1974.

  • Bazil and Geraldine marry

    Coutts and Geraldine marry when Father Cassidy is still in Pluto: "Father Cassidy said he would not solemnize thier vows" (267), and after Evelina comes back from the hospital, as she attends thier wedding. When Evelina goes with Seraph to the hospital on Halloween following her return home (October 31st 1973) she says that "[a] year later" Father Cassidy "quit the priesthood, went home, grew a beard, and became an entreprener"(261). Therefore, in order for Evelina and Father Cassidy to be in Pluto at the time of the wedding, it would've had to take place between October 31st 1973 and October 31st 1974.
